notes: SHIP v1.14.389 - PHASE 2 FEATURE-COMPLETE. The eight remaining owner-listed items are built. ALL WRITES GO THROUGH THE EXISTING HARDENED PATH - checklist_toggle, checklist_setNote and deploy_advancePhase. No new writer, no raw localStorage write, no new storage key. (1)(2) CAMERA RAIL AND CABLES: rackElevation_render3D already builds FRONT/ISO/TOP/REAR, EXPLODE and the CABLES chip, but only when it can find a .reh-3d-toggle strip - it does a document.querySelector for one and appends the rail to that strip PARENT. The Build card now provides that strip, so the EXISTING controls light up with zero changes to the scene, the rail or the locked internals. Verified live: FRONT, ISO, TOP, REAR, EXPLODE all present, and the cables control renders NO CABLE DATA on a rack that genuinely has none, which is the honest state rather than an empty toggle. (3) OPEN AISLE was already shipped and still routes to forge3d_open. (4)-(7) CONTEXTUAL TOOL TABS: Port Map, BOM, Manifest and Rack Map, each opening the canonical tool through rd_openOpsTool(tab, backAction) with a back action of showMode(work), so the tool opens in the Build flow and Back returns to the workspace instead of stranding the tech. (8) WORKLIST: the current phase checklist rendered from real items with their real met/unmet state; a phase with no items says so rather than showing an empty frame. (9) EVIDENCE: a per-item note written with checklist_setNote, which debounces its own save; cancelling the prompt writes nothing, and a saved note renders under the item and flips the control to Evidence-check. (10) COMPLETION: per-item completion through checklist_toggle, and a phase-completion action through deploy_advancePhase - the writer that already owns the audit entry, the rack cache and the deployment timestamp. VERIFIED BY ACTUALLY WRITING, not by reading: clicking Complete NETWORK advanced the seeded rack from Phase 3 of 5 to Phase 4 of 5 and the workspace re-rendered against the new state. One wording bug was caught and fixed in the same pass - a phase with zero checklist items was rendering as Complete NETWORK - 0 open and taking the gold partial treatment; a phase with nothing open is not partial, and the count now only appears when there are genuinely unmet items. PHASE 2 IS NOW FEATURE-COMPLETE ON PHONE, LAPTOP AND DESKTOP and is ready for the consolidated end-to-end verification. NOTE ON THE TABS: they open the existing tool surfaces through the canonical door rather than embedding those tools as panes inside the Build workspace. Embedding would mean re-hosting four mature tools and is a far larger change than this ruling asked for; the doors, the back path and the state are all real. Say the word if you want them embedded instead. DEVICE-VERIFY - THE FULL PROGRAM: phone bare URL, Command unchanged and BUILD opening the Active Rack workspace; camera rail, CABLES and OPEN AISLE; all four tool tabs opening and Back returning to Build; worklist items toggling and persisting across a reload; evidence notes saving; phase completion advancing the phase; SCAN and LOG BLOCKER; bottom nav; airplane mode. Laptop at your own viewport: persistent nav, dominant workspace, readable rail, no third column, no clipping. Desktop at 1440, 1600 and 1728. Legacy at ?legacy=1 with the launcher intact and RETURN TO NEW UI working.
